name: Leaderboard
summary: A game or challenge leaderboard: a podium for the top three with a crown for first, ranked rows with how far each moved up or down, your own row pinned and highlighted, and a this week or all time switch.
use: in a game, fitness challenge or learning streak, for showing who leads and where you stand
a11y: Ordered lists in rank order (the podium is reordered only visually); each rank change is said in words, your row has aria-current, and the period switch is a native radio group.
